items.title: Volkswagen launches China-supplied cars in Uzbekistan, eyes growth markets expansion
items.summary: Volkswagen has officially launched its Volkswagen and Jetta brands in Uzbekistan, a significant move marking its first export market managed entirely through its China operations.

items.title: Maruti, Mahindra and Tata Motors eye UK market to sell India-made EVs under FTA
items.summary: The agreement, set to come into force on July 15, permits duty-free exports of electric, hybrid and hydrogen-powered passenger vehicles from the sixth year onwards across price bands ranging from under £20,000 to £80,000.

items.title: Porsche CEO aims to finalise new cost-cutting package by July
items.summary: Porsche is also set for closer collaboration with Audi and will continue its entry-level 718 series, as it navigates challenges like tariffs and geopolitical issues.

items.title: Porsche India opens largest dealership in Hyderabad, expands network to 14 sales touchpoints
items.summary: The centre adopts Porsche's global 'Destination Porsche' retail concept, offering an experience-led environment aimed at enhancing customer engagement with the brand beyond conventional vehicle retail.

items.title: Porsche's promised comeback does little to calm investors over China
items.summary: Porsche's new CEO, Michael Leiters, has urged shareholders for patience, promising a detailed turnaround plan by October 7. Investors are demanding urgent action following a significant profit margin slump and declining sales in China.

items.title: New Avore Electric Motorcycle Teased Ahead Of Launch – 250+ Kms Range?
items.summary: Recently spotted testing in Ahmedabad, Avore’s upcoming electric motorcycle appears to target the premium mid-size segment with sporty styling, advanced features The post New Avore Electric Motorcycle Teased Ahead Of Launch – 250+ Kms Range? appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: Reliance New Energy prepares battery-swapping rollout for EV two-wheelers in logistics, delivery segment
items.summary: This move targets the delivery and logistics sector. The company has secured necessary certifications for batteries and vehicles. Initial trials will occur within Reliance's own fleet.

items.title: Brembo, Ningbo SAFE Form Joint Venture To Manufacture Motorcycle ABS Systems In India
items.summary: Brembo and China's Ningbo SAFE Brakes Systems have signed a joint venture agreement to establish a new company, BRSF Active Safety Solutions, focused on the production of anti-lock braking systems (ABS) for motorcycles in India. The venture aims to address growing demand for advanced braking technologies in the country's two-wheeler market, which accounts for up to 25 million registered vehicles annually.

items.title: Motovolt Deploys Over 200 MVS7 Electric Vehicles Through GBG EV Partnership in Delhi NCR
items.summary: Motovolt Mobility has expanded its partnership with electric vehicle fleet rental operator GBG EV, deploying more than 200 units of its MVS7 electric two-wheelers for last-mile delivery operations across Delhi NCR. The vehicles are equipped with battery-swapping technology supplied by Indofast.

items.title: Top Indian Tyre Makers Line Up Over ₹7,500 Crore Capex For FY27
items.summary: India’s leading tyre makers are preparing a fresh round of capital expenditure for FY27 and the years ahead, as capacity utilisation across key product categories moves close to peak levels and demand remains steady across replacement and original equipment channels. Apollo Tyres, CEAT, JK Tyre & Industries and Balkrishna Industries have together outlined large capex plans covering truck and bus radial tyres, pass...

items.title: UltraTech deploys 45 e-trucks for clinker transportation in northern India
items.summary: The initiative is expected to reduce more than 8,900 tonnes of CO2 emissions annually and displace around 2.9 million litres of diesel consumption each year.

items.title: Ferrari names new marketing chief after Luce EV debut
items.summary: Ferrari has appointed Massimiliano Di Silvestre, formerly of BMW Italy, as its new chief marketing and commercial officer, replacing Enrico Galliera after 16 years. Di Silvestre, with over two decades of automotive experience, will join Ferrari's leadership team on July 1.

items.title: China's BYD ramps up battery production in Brazil
items.summary: Chinese electric carmaker BYD is boosting battery production in Brazil. The company plans significant investment in energy storage systems to support Brazil's national grid. This expansion is part of a strategy to become Brazil's top car brand by 2030.

items.title: Tata Motors FY 31 Launch Plans – 15 ICE Cars and 10 EVs
items.summary: By FY31, Tata's portfolio would have expanded to include 6 new ICE models, 4 new EVs and various facelifts and refreshes The post Tata Motors FY 31 Launch Plans – 15 ICE Cars and 10 EVs appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: Tata Motors to invest up to ₹40,000 crore by FY31
items.summary: The company targets a 20% domestic market share by FY31, with electric and CNG vehicles driving significant growth. This ambitious plan includes expanding its EV lineup and enhancing battery technology to address adoption barriers, positioning Tata Motors for a multi-powertrain future.

items.title: Tata Motors, Mahindra grab top two spots in ICCT's Global Automaker Ranking 2025 for EV energy efficiency
items.summary: The report says stronger regulations and faster EV adoption could help India reduce oil imports, improve energy security and boost domestic manufacturing.

items.title: Force Motors Assembles 200,000th Mercedes-Benz Engine at Chakan Manufacturing Facility
items.summary: Force Motors Limited has completed the assembly of its 200,000th engine for Mercedes-Benz India at its dedicated powertrain manufacturing facility in Chakan, Pune. The milestone unit, a six-cylinder M256 engine, was allocated for installation into a Mercedes-Benz GLS 450 luxury SUV.

items.title: Dacia launches 2nd-generation Spring EV, retains focus on affordable electric mobility
items.summary: The Renault Group-owned brand said the new Spring will continue to offer a fully electric powertrain, four-seat configuration and practical boot space, staying true to Dacia's value-oriented approach.

items.title: India readies ₹12,000 crore push for local battery component manufacturing
items.summary: India is set to launch a new incentive scheme to boost local manufacturing of advanced cell battery components. This initiative aims to reduce import dependence for crucial materials like cathode and anode active materials, electrolysers, and copper foil separators.

items.title: Endurance Technologies Commences Commercial Output at Mindewadi Battery Pack Plant
items.summary: Endurance Technologies Limited has commenced commercial production of lithium ion battery packs at its newly constructed greenfield manufacturing facility in Mindewadi, located in the Maval taluka of Pune district, Maharashtra. The operational milestone follows a capital expenditure approval originally finalized by the company board of directors on 29 April 2025.

items.title: PLI, duty incentives soon for lithium, nickel processing units in India
items.summary: This strategic move aims to reduce reliance on overseas processors and bolster the nation's critical minerals ecosystem. The initiative supports the National Critical Minerals Mission and aligns with projected growth in demand for electric vehicle batteries.

items.title: Passenger vehicle sales expected to grow 4-6%in FY27: Report
items.summary: Passenger vehicle sales are poised for a 4-6% per cent expansion this fiscal year, fueled by strong consumer demand, enhanced affordability post-GST rate adjustments, and the enduring popularity of utility vehicles. While exports remain robust and electric vehicle adoption is accelerating, rising fuel costs and monsoon concerns are key watchpoints.

items.title: Battery PLI scheme stumbles as no penalties realised, beneficiaries now want extension
items.summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries has been issuing quarterly penalty notices to defaulting companies which have missed capacity installation deadlines, but not a single rupee has been realised so far.

items.title: BS-7 and CAFÉ-II: How regulatory norms are reshaping a high-value growth cycle for India’s auto component manufacturers
items.summary: While regulations are evolving, the focus is on higher technology intensity and platform consolidation. This transition is positioning India as a global export hub for emission-compliant technologies, promising margin-led growth in a multi-powertrain era.

items.title: Customs Department Levies ₹97.6 Lakh Tax and Penalty Order on Uno Minda
items.summary: Uno Minda Limited has received an official assessment order from the Office of the Commissioner of Customs demanding payment for unpaid anti-dumping duties related to the import of industrial machinery. The regulatory disclosure, submitted to the domestic stock exchanges on June 17, 2026, outlines an aggregate monetary demand of 97.62 lakh rupees.
